Just terrible
Apr 2019 • Friends
Doesn't even deserve one star. Location is perfect but that's all. Staff doesn't greet or welcome you when you come to the restaurant, you have to get the menu yourself if you want one. After that it seems to be impossible to place an order, nobody wants to serve you. When you finally get to order your food they mess it up. We ordered appetizers and main course at the same time, got wrong appetizers almost an hour after and never got the main course, waited for 1,5h. At some point there wasn't anybody in the kitchen, and the waiters were playing with pens and staring blank. When wanting to leave it was nearly impossible to get the waiter to bring your bill, had to stand up, wave and start to leave before anyone even reacted, and even after that it took a while before anybody came. Food is below mediocre, clearly not the best but not the worst i've had either. Chinese people get service, others don't.

What a Pity
Jul 2018 • Couples
This is a very appealing restaurant located right on the beach. Its basically open air and the views are terrific, both on the sand and to the horizons. The menu was not extensive but looked good and provided for most tastes.

 Perhaps it was the day and time because all of cruise excursion buses seem to descend on this restaurant at the same time. The result was total havoc . Orders were mixed up, and those who ordered early were certainly not served amongst the first. Some didn’t even get to order and others missed out on their meal.

The restaurant simply couldn’t cope. Perhaps the cruise organisers should schedule lunches more effectively and/or over a longer time span so that all of the buses do not turn up at the same time or use a couple of restaurants to again spread the load. 

Persistent late departures from the ship for excursions certainly don’t help.
